extraction.Name: Alex Pablo
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 320 acre allotment, when it was issued, September 29, 1919, for he did not want to pay taxes; but the Indian Agency told him that, if he did not take and pay the taxes, it would be taxed just the same, and later sold for taxes; so he accepted the patent
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Joe Rudy, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $2400.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: Joe Rudy, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $2400.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold this land to get money to pay debts that he incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee
extraction.Occupation/Income: he farms some rented land; and that this is his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is generally poor; has a wife and three children to support; one child, a girl, is sickly; rest of the family are healthy; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; considers he received a fair price for his allotment; allotment was 320 acres; document sworn March 8, 1929 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
